figures.caption: Inhibition of PEDV-GFP virus by HR2-derived peptides. Huh7 cells were incubated with PEDV-GFP (MOI = 0.01) mixed with soluble HR peptides at various concentrations (5, 10, 20, and 40 μM). Viral infection was determined by counting GFP positive cell clusters. Figure represents mean ± standard error of triplicate wells. The GST was used as the control for comparison. Significant (*): p < 0.05; Very significant (**): p < 0.01.

figures.caption: Inhibition of PEDV-GFP at different steps of viral infection. HR peptides (40 μM) were used to treat Huh7 cells before (pre-treatment), during (co-treatment), and after (post-treatment) infection with PEDV-GFP. The figure represents mean ± standard error of triplicate wells. The GST was used as the control for comparison. Significant (*): p < 0.05; Very significant (**): p < 0.01.
